{"name":"Lemony Chickpea and Spinach Skillet","description":"A bright, savory one-pan chickpea dinner finished with lemon.","ingredients":[{"name":"chickpeas","quantity":"2","unit":"cans"},{"name":"baby spinach","quantity":"5","unit":"ounces"},{"name":"lemon","quantity":"1"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tablespoons"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"2","unit":"cloves"}],"instructions":["Warm the olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat and cook the sliced garlic for 30 seconds.","Add the drained chickpeas and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly golden.","Fold in the spinach until wilted, then remove from the heat and finish with lemon zest and juice."],"prepTime":8,"cookTime":15,"totalTime":23,"servings":4,"difficulty":"Easy","cuisine":"Mediterranean-inspired","dietaryTags":["vegetarian"],"tips":["Add a splash of water if the spinach needs help wilting."]}
